blockbuilder-explorer.visual_critic_note: Cohesive dark theme with CSS custom properties, deliberate muted accent (#4477AA), clear typographic hierarchy in panel labels, and a well-structured multi-view layout — but the network graph is visually noisy at rendered size, making individual node labels unreadable and the D3 API co-occurrence encoding hard to parse.
blockbuilder-explorer.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout — bar chart zero-baseline (domain [0, maxCount]), scaleSqrt correctly used for all circle encodings (network nodes and color scatter), data-driven domains via d3.extent/d3.max; minor subset-relation issue where network node scale recalculates against filtered max rather than global max, causing nodes to visually enlarge when a filter shrinks the dataset.
blockbuilder-explorer.stress_test_note: RAF dirty-flag pattern correctly coalesces all brush/interaction updates to one frame; pointer events prevent mouse-touch fight; no transitions eliminate snap risk; only weakness is absent resize handler leaving captured x/y scales stale if the viewport changes.
blockbuilder-explorer.cognitive_load_note: 4 linked panels (timeline brush, 60-node force network, color scatter, thumbnail wall) stay within working memory limits because they form a single conceptual explorer unit, but the network is near the density warning threshold and the thumbnail wall adds visual noise that could overwhelm at smaller viewports.
